problem.host: Give the site by its host, such as example.org.
problem.too_much: That is too much code for one site (256 KiB of CSS and of JavaScript at most).

remove_this: Remove the code for this site
intro: CSS reaches open pages of the site as soon as it is saved; JavaScript runs each time one of its pages has loaded. A site stands for its subdomains. The code runs as part of the page and can read and change everything on it: only add code you understand. It stays on this computer.
full: No more than {max} sites are kept.
